method: Canonical accents of the approved specification. The corporate indigo is the real tone already used by the product (former --indigo-600); the semantic ramps come from the definitive palette of the specification. Text, hover and tints are derived for WCAG AA.
note: This registry replaces the raster samples of hero-dashboard.png as the chromatic authority of foods-admin-web. The graphite neutral anchors table headers; the corporate indigo is reserved for action, selection and focus.
